title: Module 12 quiz — Terraform, Ansible and CI/CD
description: Eight questions on git, CI, ECR publish, Terraform modules, Ansible, rollback. Synthetic BayPay.

questions.prompt: What must CI run before it publishes payment-service to ECR?
questions.explanation: Red tests must not become an image tag finance will run.

questions.prompt: Why tag images with a git SHA instead of :latest?
choices: Rollback and forensics need an immutable id of the bits
questions.explanation: INCIDENT-1205 class: you must know what ran.

questions.prompt: A Terraform module for ecs_service should take which health-related variable?
choices: container port 8080 and a health path such as /actuator/health/liveness
questions.explanation: Do not hard-code `/` as the ALB path. BUILD-1202 / INCIDENT-1104.

questions.prompt: Where does Terraform state for a student sandbox belong?
choices: Committed to git next to secrets
Local or a locked remote backend — never in git with apply outputs that include secrets
questions.explanation: State can contain secrets. .gitignore local state.

questions.prompt: When is Ansible the right BayPay tool versus Terraform?
choices: Mutating leftover VM/Liberty files (server.env) after the cloud object already exists — or local config labs
questions.explanation: Terraform = cloud objects. Ansible = config on a box. BUILD-1203 is $0 local.

questions.prompt: A deploy is failing health on 8080 after CI shipped 3.8.9-debug. First stabilize?
choices: Roll back to the last healthy task definition / image (e.g. 3.8.0) and keep 8080
questions.explanation: Rollback first. Then find why the new tag listens on the wrong port.

choices: The ALB is healthy in us-west-2
The configuration is syntactically valid and internally consistent — not that apply is cheap or correct in your account
questions.explanation: Validate ≠ apply. The course bar is validate.

questions.prompt: A GitHub Actions workflow skips ./mvnw test and only docker push. What is wrong?
choices: It can publish a broken JAR to ECR that ECS will then fail to serve
questions.explanation: BUILD-1204 starter is missing the test job on purpose.
